english.title: With intent to deceive, lent or allowed to be used certificate, licence, approval, permission, exemption or document

(A)_[a certificate, namely **(..SPECIFY CERTIFICATE..), issued or having effect or required by or under the Air Navigation Order 2016]_

(H)_[a permission, namely **(..SPECIFY PERMISSION..), issued or having effect or required by or under a Safety Regulation]_

english.legislation: Contrary to articles 256(1)(b) and 265(7) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
with intent to deceive
lent a certificate, licence, approval, permission, exemption or any other document
issued or having effect or required by or under this Order or by or under a Safety Regulation
to another person
or allowed it to be used by another person

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Article 256 was amended on Exit Day to remove reference to EASA and EU-OPS - for offences prior to Exit Day, see offence document H18485.
